# openwrt_dhcp_pool (Resource)

Manages a DHCP pool for an OpenWrt network interface.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `interface` (String) The network interface to serve DHCP on (e.g., 'lan', 'guest').
- `name` (String) Name of the DHCP pool (typically matches the interface name).

### Optional

- `dhcpv4` (String) DHCPv4 mode: 'server', 'none'.
- `dhcpv6` (String) DHCPv6 mode: 'server', 'hybrid', 'none'.
- `ignore` (Boolean) Ignore this interface for DHCP (disable DHCP server).
- `leasetime` (String) DHCP lease time (e.g., '12h', '24h', 'infinite').
- `limit` (Number) Number of IPs to allocate (total = limit).
- `ra` (String) Router Advertisement mode: 'server', 'hybrid', 'relay', 'disabled'.
- `ra_flags` (List of String) RA flags (e.g., ['managed-config', 'other-config']).
- `start` (Number) First IP in the DHCP range.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Internal ID: dhcp/<interface_name>.
- `section` (String) Internal UCI section identifier (e.g. 'cfg0abc12') of the anonymous section backing this resource. Managed automatically; resolved on import.
